title: AiAgentBuilder
wrapsNative: MonarchTabs on phones and a Row of two panes at expanded width (androidx.compose.material3.adaptive.currentWindowAdaptiveInfoV2), with a verticalScroll Column of MonarchTextField, MonarchAiConnectorPicker and MonarchAiKnowledgeScope and a test pane of MonarchAiThread over MonarchAiPromptInput
summary: A recipe, not a component: a screen to define an AI agent (persona, instructions, tools and knowledge) and try the unsaved definition in a test chat.
whenToUse: Admin or builder screens where people create or edit an agent and want to test it before saving.
whenNotToUse: Picking an existing agent: use MonarchAiAgentPicker. Only choosing tools or knowledge for a conversation: use MonarchAiConnectorPicker or MonarchAiKnowledgeScope on their own.
api: if (currentWindowAdaptiveInfoV2().windowSizeClass.isWidthAtLeastBreakpoint(WindowSizeClass.WIDTH_DP_EXPANDED_LOWER_BOUND)) Row { form(Modifier.weight(1f)); VerticalDivider(); test(Modifier.weight(1f)) } else Column { PrimaryTabRow(selectedTabIndex = tab) { Tab("Configure"); Tab("Test") }; … }

form: Column(Modifier.verticalScroll(…)) { MonarchAiAgentAvatar(agent, size = MonarchAvatarSize.Lg, decorative = true); MonarchTextField(name, errorText = …); MonarchTextField(role, helperText = …); MonarchTextField(instructions, singleLine = false, helperText = "n / 8000 characters"); MonarchAiConnectorPicker(connectors, onConnectorsChange, title = "Tools", searchable = false); MonarchAiKnowledgeScope(sources, selection, onSelectionChange, expandIcon); MonarchButton("Save agent", variant = Primary) }

test: Column { MonarchAiAgentAvatar(agent, state = Working while streaming); MonarchButton("Restart test") { conversation.stop(); conversation.reset() }; MonarchAiThread(messages, Modifier.weight(1f), daySeparators = false); MonarchAiPromptInput(onSubmit = { conversation.send(it, body = mapOf("agent" to definition())) }) }

options.name: definition
options.type: App state: name, role, instructions, tool permissions (MonarchAiConnector list), knowledge ids
options.description: Held by the app and saved on Save agent; every edit clears the saved message, as the web's onChange does.

options.name: connectors
options.description: The tools the agent may use, grouped by connector with a permission per tool (allow, ask, never), shown by MonarchAiConnectorPicker. Destructive tools cannot be set to allow unless the app passes allowsDestructiveAutoApprove.

options.name: sources
options.description: Knowledge the agent can read, as a MonarchAiKnowledgeScope tree. Leave the section out without sources.

options.name: conversation
options.description: The test chat. Each test message is sent with the current definition in body under "agent", so the transport runs the unsaved agent. Leave the Test tab and pane out without it.

options.name: maxInstructions
options.description: Longest instructions; the field stops at it and its helper text counts characters.

options.name: save
options.description: Save agent checks the name, then the app saves; the status line is a polite live region that reads Agent saved.

states.name: phone
states.description: Configure and Test are two Material 3 primary tabs; the form scrolls in Configure and the test chat fills Test.

states.name: expanded width
states.description: From 840dp the form and the test chat show side by side with a vertical divider.

states.name: name missing
states.description: After Save agent with an empty name, the name field shows "Give the agent a name." as its error and nothing is saved.

states.name: saved
states.description: The status line reads Agent saved until the next edit.

states.name: testing
states.description: The avatar reads Working while the reply streams; Restart test stops and clears the test conversation.

states.name: empty test
states.description: The thread shows "Send a message to try the agent."

appearance: Every part is an existing component: MonarchTextField, MonarchAiConnectorPicker, MonarchAiKnowledgeScope, MonarchAiAgentAvatar, MonarchAiThread, MonarchAiPromptInput and MonarchButton, with Material 3 primary tabs and a subtle-border divider in the Monarch theme. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those components.
platformNotes: The web ships AiAgentBuilder as one component with the form and the test chat side by side and stacked on narrow screens. On Android the phone form is two primary tabs, Configure and Test, so the test chat gets the whole screen and its lazy thread never sits inside the scrolling form; at expanded width (840dp, the Material window size class) the two show side by side. The web's tool checkbox list is MonarchAiConnectorPicker, which groups tools by connector and gives each an allow, ask or never permission, as the plan's dependency asks; the definition sends the allowed and asked tool ids. The web's avatar URL field is the app's own picker beside MonarchAiAgentAvatar, since Monarch loads no images. The web's save promise with progress and error is the app's own call; this recipe shows the saved state as a polite live region and the missing name as the field's error. The web moves focus to the name field when the name is missing; this recipe does not move focus. iOS has not covered this entry yet.
accessibility: Persona, Instructions and Knowledge are MonarchText headings; Tools is the connector picker's title.
The name field shows its error as text and reports it to TalkBack through MonarchTextField's error semantics.
The character count is the instructions field's helper text, read with the field.
The saved message is a polite live region, announced without moving focus.
Configure and Test are Material 3 tabs with the tab role and selected state.
The avatars are decorative; the agent's name is in the name field and the test messages.
edgeCases: Keep the test thread out of the scrolling form: on phones it is its own tab, at expanded width its own pane.
A test send while a tool call waits for approval is refused and the text comes back into the prompt input.
Edits after a save clear the saved message, so it never claims an unsaved edit was saved.
Long instructions stop at the limit; pasted text over it is cut to the limit.
